name: SendGrid Integration Simplenews Reports
description: Adds a per-newsletter-node SendGrid statistics tab (charts + CSV export) for Simplenews issues.
project_description:
This module provides SendGrid statistics integration for Simplenews nodes. It adds a dedicated "SendGrid Statistics" tab to Simplenews nodes, allowing you to view detailed delivery analytics for each specific newsletter.

 This module is designed for the 2.x branch of SendGrid Integration module, and will support future branch releases.

 Features 
 
 View detailed SendGrid statistics for individual Simplenews nodes via a dedicated node tab 
 Access comprehensive metrics including sending volume, spam reports, browser statistics, and device usage 
 Filter statistics by custom date ranges 
 Export reports in CSV format 
 Visual data representation through charts and graphs 
 Detailed bounce and unsubscribe tracking 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 SendGrid Integration 
 SendGrid Integration Reports (submodule of SendGrid Integration) 
 Simplenews 
 
 NOTE! This patch is currently required for full functionality. This is why the module is in alpha state now. You can help to move forward by reviewing this ticket .
